mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comments (post_id, parent_comment_id, user_id, content) VALUES (#{postId}, #{parentCommentId}, #{userId}, #{content})
mapper.select: SELECT c.id AS comment_id, c.parent_comment_id, pan.nickname, c.content, c.created_at, CASE WHEN c.user_id = #{userId} THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS isMine, c.status FROM comments c LEFT JOIN post_anonymous_nickname pan ON pan.post_id = c.post_id AND pan.user_id = c.user_id WHERE c.post_id = #{postId} ORDER BY c.created_at ASC
SELECT user_id FROM comments WHERE id = #{commentId}
SELECT post_id FROM comments WHERE id = #{commentId}
mapper.update: UPDATE comments SET status = 'DELETED' WHERE id = #{commentId}
